rules.name: Rousing Song
rules.description: As a Special Action, Pantea may take a Speech Skill Test. If successful, all friendly models within 3" (including Pantea herself), gain a -2 modifier to Morale checks until the end of the round.

rules.name: Eternal Thanks
rules.description: Each time you complete a Quest during the game, roll [SKILL DIE]. On a [CRITICAL MISS], Katria's work on the mortal plane is complete and she is removed from play (she does not count as a casualty). Gain 1 bonus VP for the Quest.

rules.name: Ghostly Equipment
rules.description: All weapons equipped by Katria have the Enchanted keyword.

rules.name: Pirate Hunter
rules.description: Adelaisa and friendly Followers within 3" add [YELLOW] to their attack rolls versus models with the Bandits faction symbol.

rules.name: Arkay's Mercy (Leveled)
rules.description: As a Special Action, tthe Priestess and each friendly model within 3" may take an Endurance Attribute Test. If successful, they restore 1 Health point lost earlier in the battle.

rules.name: Imporant Message!
rules.description: This model is not deployed with the rest of a party before the game. At the beginning of Round 3, this model is placed in contact with a random board edge. Once per game [correction: battle], if this model performs a Special Action whilst within 3" of its party Champion, gain 3 VPs.

rules.name: Illusion Master
rules.description: If the Altmer Illusionist is not engaged at the end of its activation, spend 2 Magicka to perform an Illusion Skill Test.  If successful, the Altmer Illusionist is Terrifying until it next activates.

rules.name: Healing Spells
rules.description: If the Altmer Legionary is not engaged at the end of its activation, spend 2 Magicka to perform a Restoration Skill Test.  If successful, restore 2 Health.

rules.name: Forester
rules.description: This model does not suffer the Difficult Terrain penalty when moving through Area Terrain of the woodland type.

rules.name: Light of Stendarr
rules.description: If at the end of an activation the Bosmer Vigil is within 6" of any Enemy Undead or Vampire models, spend 3 Magicka and perform a Restoration Skill Test.  If successful, [deal] 1 damage [to] all Undead or Vampire models within 6".

rules.name: Potion of Magicka [*]
rules.description: Once per game, at the beginning of its activation (before replenishing reserves) if the Breton Destruction Mage has no points remaining in its Magicka Reserve, restore it to full.

rules.name: Illusionist
rules.description: If the Breton Stalker ends an activation unengaged and not within Clear Line of Sight of an Enemy model, take an Illusion Skill Test.  If successful, assign a Hidden Token to the Breton Stalker.

rules.name: Dual Wielder
rules.description: If the Dunmer Twinblade is engaged with multiple enemy models, add [GREEN] to all Melee Attacks.

rules.name: Potion of Magicka [*]
rules.description: Once per game, at the beginning of its activation (before replenishing reserves) if the Imperial Destruction Mage has no points remaining in its Magicka Reserve, restore it to full.

rules.name: Shield Drills
rules.description: When performing a Shield Bash against an enemy model, spend an additional point of Stamina to deal [YELLOW] damage to the target.

rules.name: Throwing Dagger [*]
rules.description: If at the end of its activation the Khajiit Twinblade is within 6" of any enemy model, perform an Archery Skill Test.  If successful, [deal] [YELLOW][YELLOW] damage [to] the target. [RAI: against each? Needs official clarification.]

rules.name: Headsman
rules.description: If at the end of its Activation the Orc Headsman is within 3" of an enemy Incapacitated model, perform a Two-Handed Skill Test.  If successful, remove the enemy model as a casualty.

rules.name: Unpredictable Behaviour
rules.description: At the start of each of Sulla's Activations, roll [BLACK].  On a [OBLIVION] Sulla recieves the Extra Action keyword for the duration of this Activation.  On a [SWORDS], he lashes out uncontrollably - the closest friendly model within 3" and Line of Sight loses 1 Health point (Armor Rating is ignored). On a [HELMET], nothing happens. [RAI: Proceed with rest of Activation]

rules.name: Reluctant Companion
rules.description: Umana has the Bodyguard keyword, but only targeting a friendly Sulla Trebatius model, even if he is not the Party Champion.  However, if Umana ever recieves damage as a result of Sulla's [Unpredictable Behaviour] special rule, [Umana loses] this rule for the rest of the game.

rules.name: Necroanimus
rules.description: Arondil begins the game with the unique Spell "Summon Yngvild Ghost" (included in his Septim cost). Arondil may have up to three Yngvild Ghosts in play at any time (including those in his Entourage). Yngvild Ghosts are not treated as Summoned Creatures, even when they are Summoned into play, and thus Arondil is free to Summon other creatures in addition to his Ghosts.

rules.name: The Dreamstride
rules.description: As a Special Action, Erandur may take an Alchemy Skill Test. If successful, he becomes Ethereal for the rest of the round. On a [FAILURE], he loses 1 Health point.
